10k.note: Latest 10-K available; Haemonetics is a blood and plasma technology medtech; product pipeline relates to medical devices (apheresis systems, hemostasis monitoring), not drug candidates.

website.error: Not applicable - medtech/blood-management company; no proprietary drug pipeline page

ctgov.note: Only 2 trials referencing Haemonetics; both COMPLETED. NCT01359878 sponsor is Copenhagen University Hospital (Haemonetics is collaborator). NCT02145507 was an internal blood-additive solution (AS-7/SOLX) feasibility study, COMPLETED 2014; no follow-on active program.

commercial_product.note: Haemonetics is a medical-technology company providing blood and plasma supply-chain management. Key product franchises: NexSys PCS / NexLynk DMS plasma collection; Cell Saver Elite+ surgical autotransfusion; TEG 6s hemostasis analyzer; VASCADE / VASCADE MVP vascular closure systems (acquired via Cardiva); Vivasure Medical (PerQseal closure devices, acquired 2024). No proprietary therapeutic P1/P2/P3 drug development programs.

excluded_legacy_terminated.reason: COMPLETED 2014 - SOLX/AS-7 whole blood additive feasibility, no successor program

excluded_partner_owned.reason: Copenhagen University Hospital sponsor; Haemonetics among many collaborators / funders

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Adjacent medtech (blood and plasma technology) - no proprietary clinical drug pipeline. Haemonetics develops and sells medical devices (apheresis, autotransfusion, hemostasis analyzers, vascular closure devices). Device improvements are validated through 510(k) / IDE pathways and post-market clinical evidence rather than drug-style P1/P2/P3 trials.
